title: Parametric 3D Modeling in Landscape Architecture
description:
Prerequisite: LARC221 or LARC489O or permission of instructor.
Recommended: No prior experience in Rhino or Grasshopper is required; however, semi-proficiency in Sketchup, Rhino or other 3D modeling software is encouraged.
Restriction: Relatively strong familiarity with AutoCAD is mandatory for this course and students must, be in the upper levels of the landscape architectural program or equivalent outside of the LARC program.
